task.prompt: Please update current_procedure.sql for change_request.md without changing the interface: sp(arg1 integer, arg2 text, arg3 integer, arg4 text, arg5 integer). arg1 is the student identifier, arg2 the student gender/status text, arg3 the restaurant-kind identifier, arg4 the restaurant-kind description text or pattern, and arg5 the numeric rating value. Keep unrelated behavior as-is. Return the complete PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL stored procedure, and nothing else.

materials.text: Broaden the existing branch behavior. For arg1 below 10, that path should also set matching earlier restaurant types to the description 'DEFAULT'. For arg1 at least 10 and below 25, if the restaurant-type cursor finds no restaurant types numbered greater than arg3 with a description matching arg4 as a pattern, set the restaurant type numbered exactly arg3 to 'NO_MATCH'. For arg1 at least 25 and below 40, after the existing rating-range restaurants are selected, reduce restaurant ratings greater than 200 by 15; while scanning fetched restaurants, remember whether any fetched rating was greater than 100, and use that for the later removal of restaurants rated greater than 150. For arg1 at least 40, each fetched student with an even identifier greater than half arg1 should get gender status 'PROCESSED' and city code 'EVEN'. After the scan, if any such students were found, set those students' academic major to arg5 and raise every restaurant rating below arg5 up to arg5; otherwise set the restaurant type numbered exactly arg3 to 'NO_EVEN_STUDENTS'.
